units.rawText: I once took care of an elderly lady in a sanatorium.
units.displayText: I once took care of an elderly lady in a sanatorium.

spans.text: I once took care of an elderly lady in a sanatorium.

units.rawText: She was so kindly and beautiful. Well, I say I took care of her, but it was more like the other way round.
units.displayText: She was so kindly and beautiful. Well, I say I took care of her, but it was more like the other way round.

spans.text: She was so kindly and beautiful. Well, I say I took care of her, but it was more like the other way round.

units.rawText: I also learned a lot from her, like singing, painting... She taught me all that.
units.displayText: I also learned a lot from her, like singing, painting... She taught me all that.

spans.text: I also learned a lot from her, like singing, painting... She taught me all that.

units.rawText: There was also a nice lady with blue hair who took care of her with me. She was very pretty, too.
units.displayText: There was also a nice lady with blue hair who took care of her with me. She was very pretty, too.

spans.text: There was also a nice lady with blue hair who took care of her with me. She was very pretty, too.

units.rawText: But I haven't seen her in a very long time.
